purpose: Reproducible integrated snapshot for the overseas Japanese-player tracker after verified August 20-25 updates, including retained JFW Rating refinements and the confirmed Koki Ogawa transfer from NEC Nijmegen to FC Machida Zelvia, which moves him from the tracked Eredivisie scope to out-of-scope J1 while preserving all historical overseas records.
verifiedCorrections: All verified August 20-24 overlays remain retained in manifest order, including Premier League, Championship, Bundesliga, Belgian Pro League, Eredivisie, La Liga, Ligue 1, Scottish Premiership and Primeira Liga corrections and JFW Rating refinements already present before this run.
J1 remains excluded from this repository in accordance with workflow_policy v19 and is not used as a collection, consistency or update-blocking condition.

On 2026-08-24, FC Machida Zelvia officially announced the permanent transfer of Koki Ogawa from NEC Nijmegen. The current player membership is therefore changed from NEC Nijmegen/Eredivisie to FC Machida Zelvia/J1 with changeType=transfer and effective date 2026-08-24. Historical overseas match, competition and club aggregates are retained, ranking eligibility for already tracked season data is preserved, and future automatic match collection is frozen because J1 is out of scope.
declaredCoverageGaps: Advanced player statistics remain missing where no exhaustive public source was verified; these fields stay missing and remain priority-update targets.

API-Football scheduled synchronization remains disabled until provider-ID registration, per-league completed-fixture field inventory, reconciliation, quota retry and consistency gates in workflow_policy v19 pass.
No new JFW Rating is created by the Koki Ogawa transfer itself because it is a membership change rather than a new playerMatchStats event.
J1 is intentionally outside this repository's tracking scope and is not a coverage gap for japanese-football-watch.
